text: Why do people think the writer is mad?
zh: 为什么人们认为作者疯了？
zh_hant: 為什麼人們認為作者瘋了？

text: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard
zh: 我住在机场附近，过往的飞机声可以听到
zh_hant: 我住在機場附近，過往的飛機聲可以聽到

text: The airport was built years ago,
but for some reason it could not be used then.
zh: 但当时由于某种原因无法使用。
zh_hant: 但當時由於某種原因無法使用。

text: Last year, however, it came into use.
zh: 然而，去年它开始投入使用了。
zh_hant: 然而，去年它開始投入使用了。

text: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
zh: 噪音肯定已迫使一百多人离开了家园。
zh_hant: 噪音肯定已迫使一百多人離開了家園。

text: I am one of the few people left.
zh: 我是留下的少数人之一。
zh_hant: 我是留下的少數人之一。

text: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
zh: 有时我觉得这房子会被过往的飞机撞毁。
zh_hant: 有時我覺得這房子會被過往的飛機撞毀。

text: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away,
but I am determined to stay here.
Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.
zh: 每个人都说我肯定疯了，他们很可能说得对。
zh_hant: 每個人都說我肯定瘋了，他們很可能說得對。
